--- Comment #2 from Elin Waring (<mailto:elin.waring@gmail.com|elin.waring@gmail.com>) ---
I found a discussion of this question on StackOverflow circa 2022.

<https://stackoverflow.com/questions/70654391/r-package-documentation-link-to-a-whole-package-not-function>

Basically, whether and how to do this will depend on whether the package
maintainer has created an index page and also whether you want hyperlinks.
